answer: Deposit-indexed bandwidth: an identity's action rate is metered by a refundable locked deposit, like a lantern sized only for the fuel it carries. One wallet funding a thousand clones stands on a crumbling ledge of dust: each clone crawls at dust-tier speed while its locked capital earns nothing, so the swarm's total lock-up equals buying one honest reputation outright, plus coordination overhead. The whole nebula of agent traffic runs through this meter, and deposits unlock only after an epoch of honest behavior. Attackers pay full price upfront; honest agents get their deposit back.
